headline: Heavy Fighting Persists in Expanse, Nevish and Strand
war_summary: Three hours since the last edition the wires show Marban Hollow fallen silent with no flips in the last two hours after thirteen in six and twenty-six in the day around Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall, holding at four Warden, three Colonial and one neutral. The Weathered Expanse remains the heaviest desk with two late flips and forty-six in the day at Frostmarch, Crow's Nest and Wightwalk, now two Warden, four Colonial and three neutral, and 661 Colonial and 772 Warden casualties in two hours. Kuura Strand reports three late flips and thirty-one in the day at Faden Point and Menneen and now stands six Colonial with no neutral ground. Nevish Line stays close behind with one late flip and twenty-three in the day at Tomb Father and Princefal, holding five Warden to three Colonial amid 799 Colonial and 742 Warden casualties in two hours. Linn Mercy records no late flips despite 551 Colonial and 795 Warden casualties in two hours around Outwich Ranch, while Callahan's Passage reports heavy losses with no recorded flip.
